say.text: WePicHTML is the web version of WePic: live weather for any city, over a full-screen photo of the place.
say.speak: We-Pic HTML is the web version of We-Pic: live weather for any city, over a full-screen photo of the place.

say.text: It runs in any browser, at wepic.vercel.app.
say.speak: It runs in any browser, at we-pic dot vercel dot app.

say: Every visit opens on a random city, picked from forty-five places around the world.
Or search for any city you like.
A glass card shows the conditions:
temperature, wind, rain, humidity, sunrise and sunset, and the local time there,
plus the next fifteen hours, in three-hour steps.
OpenWeather conditions are reduced to six simple keywords, like rain, snow or clear.
Unsplash is searched for the city with that keyword, and then for the city alone.
Every photo is checked to load before it is shown.
It is built with plain JavaScript modules and no framework.
Small Vercel functions call OpenWeather and Unsplash, so the API keys never reach the browser.
This web app was the first version of the idea, later rebuilt as a native Android app.

say.speak: We-Pic HTML. Live weather, real places.
